summary: The change does what was asked. The producer brief now has a "Recurring failure classes" section, built from the recorded introspections and the class registry. It lists only classes seen in at least 3 distinct jobs, with the title, the case count and the newest proposed prevention. Most cases come first, at most 5 classes are listed, each text is cut to 300 characters, and the section says how many qualifying classes were left out. Titles and preventions are quoted as data, and the section says they are not instructions. run.rs fills the section from the records loaded from the real repository, and the planner, critic and reader briefs are untouched. I ran the 6 new tests in athena-context and the budgets test; all passed. Athena's fmt, clippy and full test runs passed too. One minor finding: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs is changed but is not on the deliverables list. The change is a one-line test-fixture fix that the new struct field needs in order to compile.
